subject: Order Fixing the Day on Which this Order Is Made as the Day on Which Sections 29 and 47 of the Build Canada Homes Act Comes into Force
precis: Order fixing the day on which this order is made as the day on which sections 29 and 47 of the Build Canada Homes Act comes into force in order to bring into force the remaining provisions of the Act, except section 41, that are required to support Build Canada Homes’ (BCH) transition to BCH Crown corporation (BCH-Crown) operations.
